components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; background: oklch(0.6 0.18 250); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.54 0.16 250); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6 0.15 250 / 0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions, less emphasis than primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; background: oklch(0.96 0.008 80); color: oklch(0.3 0.02 260); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.93 0.008 80); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6 0.15 250 / 0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.25 0.015 260); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.955 0.006 80 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6 0.15 250 / 0.4); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Input Field
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: oklch(0.985 0.003 85); color: oklch(0.25 0.015 260); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid oklch(0.93 0.006 80 / 0.8); border-radius: 0.75rem; outline: none; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.5 0.02 260 / 0.7); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.93 0.006 80); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.6 0.15 250); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6 0.15 250 / 0.4); }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: oklch(0.995 0.002 85); color: oklch(0.25 0.015 260); border-radius: 1.125rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.91 0.008 80 / 0.5); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.91 0.008 80 / 0.5), 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; } .ds-card-content { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card-content p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small label for status or category.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.6 0.18 250); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-badge--secondary { background: oklch(0.96 0.008 80); color: oklch(0.3 0.02 260); } .ds-badge--outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.25 0.015 260); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.91 0.008 80); }

narrative.overview:
A trusted friend at the kitchen table, helping you make sense of mortgage numbers. Not a banker behind a desk. Not a flashy app demanding attention. Just calm, competent guidance that respects both your time and your intelligence.

The system draws from PRODUCT.md's personality: calm, trustworthy, clear. It rejects the stiff corporate aesthetic of generic Swedish bank apps, the gamified neon of consumer fintech, and the overwhelming data density of financial dashboards. Instead, it offers warmth without casualness, clarity without oversimplification.

Every element serves the user's task. Numbers are readable. Actions are obvious. The interface fades into the background so the user can focus on their actual question: what does my mortgage really cost?
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream backgrounds with soft blue accents
Generous corner radii (14px base) for approachability
Typography pairing: Figtree headings (friendly geometric) + Inter body (neutral clarity)
Restrained color: one accent, used sparingly
Flat surfaces that lift only on interaction

rules.name: The Restrained Rule
rules.body: The primary blue appears on 10% or less of any given screen. Its rarity is what makes it meaningful. If everything is blue, nothing is.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure white (#fff) or pure black (#000). Every neutral carries a subtle warm tint (hue 80-85) to maintain visual cohesion.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Weight and scale create hierarchy; color does not. Avoid blue headings or colorful labels. Let the type scale do the work.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only as a response to user interaction. At rest, the interface is flat. Ambient shadows are prohibited.

dos: Do use the primary Calm Blue sparingly: buttons, links, chart accents. Limit to 10% of screen area.
Do maintain the warm tint in all neutrals. Test by comparing against pure white; the difference should be visible.
Do use Figtree for headings and Inter for body text. Don't mix their roles.
Do add hover shadows to cards. The lift signals interactivity.
Do use generous corner radii. The 14px base radius is intentional; smaller radii feel corporate.
Do let numbers breathe. Financial data needs whitespace to be scannable.
donts: Don't use pure black or pure white. Always use the tinted neutrals (Ink Slate, Soft Cream, Warm White).
Don't mimic generic Swedish bank apps: stiff layouts, excessive form fields, hierarchical menu trees, corporate blue-and-white schemes.
Don't add gamification, neon colors, or playful animations. This is not Klarna. Mortgages are serious.
Don't create dense financial dashboards with multiple charts competing for attention. Show one insight at a time.
Don't use border-left or border-right as colored accent stripes on cards or alerts.
Don't use gradient text or glassmorphism.
Don't use ambient shadows. Surfaces are flat until interaction.
Don't use em dashes in copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, or periods.
